verdict.rationale: Ramp documents OAuth 2.0 with granular resource:permission scopes and explicit least-privilege guidance ('configure only the scopes your app needs'), a client-credentials flow for standalone agents with separate agent profiles in the CLI, and an agent-identity model of 'one key per agent' tied to a human sponsor with per-agent read/do permissions. A live probe confirms the MCP server publishes granular read/write scopes, and Agent Cards add merchant- and amount-scoped single-use payment credentials. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the per-agent key issuance and permission-configuration workflow.
